content.short: The ultimate, interstellar DEX in the Cardano ecosystem!
content.description:
Incubated by the legendary BlueZilla, and powered by the winning combo of the WagyuSwap and ADAPad teams, AstroSwap will be Cardano’s first DEX. Along with being the first DEX, AstroSwap will be one of the first DeFi platforms on an infinitely scalable blockchain backed by one of the most loyal communities in crypto.

What can you expect to find on AstroSwap?

With partnerships like Swapz (a cross-chain stablecoin swapping platform) and ADAPad (the first deflationary launchpad to build the Cardano ecosystem) AstroSwap will be the ultimate DEX within the network. Every project launched into the Cardano ecosystem on ADAPad will be moved through AstroSwap.

AstroSwap will set a new standard for decentralized trading with lightning-fast transactions, automatic liquidity locking, and ultra high staking and farming yields. Prepare for the lowest fees in the universe as you trade on AstroSwap: the future home of Cardano’s top projects.
